create_cron.description: Build a branch daily, weekly or monthly. A branch has at most one cron job, so this replaces any it already has.
create_cron.display_str_template: Create a Travis CI cron job.
create_cron.name: create_cron

parameters.description: The repository. Pick one, or type its owner/repo slug or Travis CI id, or paste its Travis CI URL.
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: The branch to build. It must exist on the code host and have been built by Travis CI before.
parameters.name: branch

parameters.description: How often to build the branch.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Skip a run when the branch was built in the last 24 hours.
parameters.name: dont_run_if_recent_build_exists

dont_run_if_recent_build_exists.description: Whether it skips a run when the branch was built in the last 24 hours

create_env_var.description: Add an environment variable to a repository's builds, for every branch or one. A private variable's value is hidden in build logs and never shown again. A name already used on the same branch is refused: use Update environment variable.
create_env_var.display_str_template: Create a Travis CI environment variable.
create_env_var.name: create_env_var

parameters.description: The repository. Pick one, or type its owner/repo slug or Travis CI id, or paste its Travis CI URL.
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Letters, digits and underscores, such as DEPLOY_TOKEN.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The value, kept exactly as typed.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Leave off for secrets: the value is then hidden in logs and Travis CI never returns it.
parameters.name: public

parameters.description: Only builds of this branch get it. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: branch

branch.description: The only branch it applies to, or null for all

id.description: Variable id, for Update and Delete environment variable

public.description: Whether its value shows in build logs

value.description: Its value, for a public variable only. Travis CI never returns a private one.

delete_cron.description: Delete a repository's cron job. It is checked to belong to the repository first, so a mistyped id can't remove another one.
delete_cron.display_str_template: Delete a Travis CI cron job.
delete_cron.name: delete_cron

parameters.description: The repository. Pick one, or type its owner/repo slug or Travis CI id, or paste its Travis CI URL.

parameters.name: cron_id

cron_id.description: Id of the deleted cron job

deleted.description: Always true: the cron job was deleted

delete_env_var.description: Delete an environment variable from a repository.

get_repository.description: Get one repository: its Travis CI id, default branch, whether Travis CI builds it, and its most recently started build.
get_repository.name: get_repository

get_request.description: Get a build request, such as one from Trigger build: whether Travis CI approved or rejected it, its message (for a rejection, the reason, such as no plan selected), what it noticed in the config, and any builds made from it.

trigger_build.description: Ask Travis CI to build a branch, optionally a given commit, with a message and config overrides. Travis CI decides on the request moments later: Get request, with the request id this returns, shows the build or the reason there is none. Builds only run once a plan is selected in Travis CI. It accepts 10 such requests per repository an hour.
trigger_build.name: trigger_build

parameters.description: The repository. Pick one, or type its owner/repo slug or Travis CI id, or paste its Travis CI URL.
parameters.name: repository

branch.description: Branch requested; empty means the default branch
